method: Built a checklist from BRIEF.md and the hard rules. Verified by grep (em dashes, banned words, rAF call sites, external hosts, fetch/alert) and by Playwright runs: page and console errors, network requests, rAF counting under reducedMotion, Tab and Escape on dropdown and mobile menu, scrollWidth at 400px, aria on canvases, nonblank canvases in reduced motion.

matter.best: Cleanest rule compliance: reduced motion gives zero rAF calls over 4s and 17 of 21 canvases still painted with stills; dropdown opens by Enter and closes by Escape with focus returned to the trigger.
matter.worst: Focus ring is dashed 2px and some state buttons lean on custom effects; two rAF call sites (loop plus visibility restart), still only one loop.
matter.evidence: 0 page errors, 0 console errors, only fonts.googleapis/gstatic requests. 0 em dashes, 0 banned words. 21 canvases all aria-hidden or role=img. One nav, 13 real buttons, 23 links. 400px scrollWidth 400, no overflowing element. DPR min(...,2). IO and document.hidden present. Menu: aria-expanded false to true to false via Enter then Escape. Burger tap opens, Escape closes. Buttons: primary, secondary, ghost, icon, toggle (Live preview), destructive (Scrap project), hold Crucible share moment with hint. Language notes present. Checklist: 8 of 8 elements pass, all hard rules pass.

signal.best: Everything works with no errors; keyboard menu and arrow key hint work; Escape returns focus to Platform trigger; 0 rAF calls in reduced motion.
signal.worst: A canvas extends to x=461 at 400px (clipped, so scrollWidth stays 400, but it is an overflowing element); two state-demo buttons (IDLE, ATTENTION) showed 0px outline on focus, relying on other styling.
signal.evidence: 0 page and console errors, only Google Fonts requests. 0 em dashes or banned words. 20 canvases all aria-hidden or role=img. 13 buttons, 1 nav. 400px scrollWidth 400. rAF sites 2 (loop plus restart); loop about 55 calls per second when running. Dropdown aria-expanded toggles by Enter and Escape, mobile burger opens and Escape closes. Reduced motion: 16 of 20 canvases painted, 0 rAF. Hold Space share moment with hint, language section present. Checklist: 8 of 8 pass, minor 400px canvas overflow.

sky.best: Covers every button type (primary, secondary, ghost link, icon burger, toggle Live sky, destructive Cancel event, hold button); reduced motion stops the loop (only 4 one-shot rAF during settle, 0 after).
sky.worst: The main desktop menu is a header with a ul and not a nav element (the only nav is the mobile list inside the mega panel); dropdown does not open on hover, click or Enter only; only 4 of 6 canvases painted in reduced motion.
sky.evidence: 0 page and console errors, fonts only. 0 em dashes or banned words. 6 canvases aria-hidden. 15 buttons. 400px scrollWidth 400, no overflow. Trigger #trig aria-expanded false to true to false on Enter then Escape, focus returned. Burger tap sets expanded true, Escape closes. rAF sites 3 including a reduced-motion one-shot. Hold to gather share moment with hint, Try it hint, notes section present. Checklist: 8 of 8 pass, nav-element rule partially met.

creatures.best: Most complete interactivity: six button states, habitats dropdown with arrow keys and Escape, mobile menu, secret word and hold-to-charge, all without errors.
creatures.worst: Violates the reduced motion no-loops rule: with reducedMotion emulated the shared rAF loop keeps ticking at about 55 calls per second (111 in 2s) because frame() re-queues itself unconditionally and never stops; a menu panel also adds an extra rAF call site.
creatures.evidence: 0 page and console errors, fonts only. 0 em dashes or banned words. 19 canvases all aria-hidden or role=img. 20 buttons, 1 nav. 400px scrollWidth 400. Habitats Enter opens, Escape closes with focus back; burger tap opens, Escape closes. Reduced motion: 14 of 19 canvases painted but rAF delta 111 over 2s (fail). rAF sites 3 (loop, panel open class toggle, boot). Checklist: 8 of 8 elements pass, hard rule reduced-motion no loops fails.

one_line_verdict: Matter passes every brief item and hard rule I could test, including a fully stopped rAF loop under reduced motion, while Creatures keeps its loop running there.
